detail.longDescription: We are starting a new family project, and I have been struggling with some of the finer details. On my morning walk, I started a voice conversation with ChatGPT in which I explored some of the items. This was my first time really spending time talking with an AI agent instead of typing in a window. WOW - I was truly blown away. Not only did I finish my walk in good time, I had the opportunity to explore different angles to the project I had not yet considered. For me, this was a true game changer in the way I want to tackle problems in the future. I was more motivated at the end of my walk than the beginning. I realize some people hate AI, but I honestly find the voice conversations very helpful when dealing with complex issues. I am curious: How many others on HN have voice conversations with AI? What is your experience? Do you find it immersive or not? Do you keep the topics to technical stuff, or do you explore other things?
